title: Northstar synthetic plan: appeal deadline
source: CC0 synthetic training fixture; fictional policy statement
text: TRAINING FIXTURE — FICTIONAL POLICY. A Northstar member may file a written appeal within 60 calendar days after receiving a claim denial notice. The appeal should include the notice, the reason the member believes the claim should be reviewed, and supporting records that the member is permitted to share. The plan administrator will confirm receipt using the contact method already on the notice. This sample document does not give a real email address, postal address, case number, or decision timeline. It does not say that an appeal will be approved. A question about the status of a specific claim cannot be answered from this general rule. The assistant should cite the 60-day deadline and tell the user which requested details are unavailable instead of fabricating a contact channel. All procedure and names in this record are invented for local education and are not legal advice.
